Definition: to slink, i.e. (by implication) to fear, or (causatively) be formidable
BiblicalUsage: 1) to fear; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to fear; 1a2) terrible (pass participle); 1b) (Pael) to cause to be afraid, make afraid
